text.en: Pick 10 leaves from the rows that look worst. Bring them home and lay each one on a plain page.
text.sw: Chuma majani kumi kutoka mistari inayoonekana vibaya. Yalete nyumbani na uyaweke juu ya karatasi safi.
text.kik: Oya mahuti ikumi kuuma mirango iria ikoragwo na thina. Urehe nyumba na umeige hari karatasi theru.

text.en: In daylight, photograph the underside of one leaf on the plain page. The leaf should fill the picture.
text.sw: Mchana, piga picha ya upande wa chini wa jani moja juu ya karatasi. Jani lijaze picha.

text.en: This photo is blurred. Hold the phone still and take it again.
text.sw: Picha hii si wazi. Shika simu bila kusogea na upige tena.

text.en: This photo is too dark. Move into daylight and take it again.
text.sw: Picha hii ni nyeusi. Nenda mwangani na upige tena.

text.en: This does not look like a coffee leaf on a plain page. Take one leaf again, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Hii haionekani kama jani la kahawa juu ya karatasi. Piga tena, au uliza afisa.

not_sure.en: A stand-in model can mistake a photo. A person should look if you are unsure.
not_sure.sw: Modeli ya mfano inaweza kukosea. Mtu aangalie kama huna uhakika.

text.en: These leaves look healthy. This tool cannot see berries, roots, or variety, so you still choose: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Majani haya yanaonekana mazima. Zana hii haioni matunda, mizizi, wala aina, kwa hiyo chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza afisa.
text.kik: Mahuti maya maronwo matari na thina. Ndiri na uhoro wa matunda kana miri. Ucagure wee: ika, eterera, kana urie afisa.

not_sure.en: Healthy here means no leaf problem showed in this sample. It is not a promise about the whole tree.
not_sure.sw: Salama hapa ina maana hakuna tatizo la jani lililoonekana. Si ahadi kuhusu mti wote.

text.en: A few leaves show signs that can be leaf rust. The line between few and many is an assumption, so ask the officer, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Majani machache yana dalili za kutu ya majani ya kahawa. Mpaka wa machache si rasmi, kwa hiyo uliza afisa, kisha chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza.

not_sure.en: No Kenyan source gives a leaf-count threshold. The officer confirms whether this few is enough to act.
not_sure.sw: Hakuna chanzo cha Kenya chenye idadi ya majani inayotakiwa. Afisa ndiye anathibitisha.

text.en: Many leaves show rust. Ask the cooperative which copper product and how much, and spray just before the rains, then again about three weeks later. You choose: act, wait, or ask the officer.
text.sw: Majani mengi yana kutu ya majani ya kahawa. Uliza chama bidhaa ya shaba na kiasi, nyunyizia kabla ya mvua, kisha tena baada ya wiki tatu. Chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza afisa.
text.kik: Mahuti maingi mena kutu. Urie andu a gikundi undu wa dawa ya shaba na wingi, mbere ya mbura, na ringi wiki ithatu. Ucagure wee.

not_sure.en: The product and the dose are not ours to give. Counting many leaves as 3 or more out of 10 is an assumption for the officer to confirm.
not_sure.sw: Bidhaa na kiasi si vyetu kutoa. Kuhesabu mengi kama 3 au zaidi kati ya 10 ni dhana, afisa athibitishe.

text.en: Many leaves show rust, and the rains are on. Ask the officer if you should wait for a dry day, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Majani mengi yana kutu ya majani ya kahawa, na mvua inaendelea. Uliza afisa kama usubiri siku kavu, kisha chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza.

not_sure.en: Spray may not hold in rain. The count of many leaves is an assumption, and the dose comes from the cooperative.
not_sure.sw: Dawa inaweza isishike mvua ikiwa. Hesabu ya mengi ni dhana, na kiasi kinatoka chama.

text.en: Many leaves show rust, and this is outside the usual spray time. Ask the officer before you spray, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Majani mengi yana kutu ya majani ya kahawa, na huu si msimu wa kawaida wa kunyunyizia. Uliza afisa kwanza, kisha chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza.

not_sure.en: Published Kenyan timing is mid-October and late February, not every dry week. The leaf count is an assumption.
not_sure.sw: Muda uliochapishwa Kenya ni katikati ya Oktoba na mwishoni mwa Februari. Hesabu ya majani ni dhana.

text.en: Brown spots with a pale centre can be brown eye spot, often worse on stressed trees. Ask the officer what to do, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye katikati nyeupe yanaweza kuwa ugonjwa wa jani, mara nyingi miti ikiwa dhaifu. Uliza afisa la kufanya, kisha chagua.

not_sure.en: No Kenyan leaflet was found for this disease. Do not treat from this card.
not_sure.sw: Hakuna karatasi ya Kenya iliyopatikana kwa ugonjwa huu. Usitende kutokana na kadi hii.

text.en: Dark round spots, or a shoot tip that dries, can be Phoma. I am not sure, so ask the officer, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Madoa meusi duara, au ncha inayokauka, yanaweza kuwa Phoma. Sina uhakika, uliza afisa, kisha chagua.

not_sure.en: No Kenyan extension page was found. This card does not say how to spray.
not_sure.sw: Hakuna ukurasa wa ugani wa Kenya uliopatikana. Kadi hii haisemi jinsi ya kunyunyizia.

text.en: Brown dry patches on top of the leaf can be leaf miner. Do not spray on your own, because sprays can kill the helpful wasps. Ask the officer, then choose.
text.sw: Mabaka ya kahawia juu ya jani yanaweza kuwa wadudu ndani ya jani. Usinyunyizie peke yako, maana dawa inaweza kuua nyigu wasaidizi. Uliza afisa, kisha chagua.

not_sure.en: There is no published Swahili name for this pest yet. The safety line is from a Kenyan extension page.
not_sure.sw: Jina la Kiswahili la mdudu huyu halijapatikana. Onyo la usalama limetoka ukurasa wa ugani wa Kenya.

text.en: More than one leaf problem shows in this sample. I will not guess which to treat. Ask the officer, then choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Kuna matatizo zaidi ya moja katika sampuli hii. Sitachagua la kutibu. Uliza afisa, kisha chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza.

not_sure.en: Mixed leaves can hide the main problem. A person should see them.
not_sure.sw: Majani mchanganyiko yanaweza kuficha tatizo kuu. Mtu ayaone.

text.en: Too many leaves are not clear, so I will not guess. Ask the officer, and retake the unclear photos in daylight.
text.sw: Majani mengi si wazi, kwa hiyo sitachagua. Uliza afisa, na upige tena picha zisizo wazi mchana.
text.kik: Mahuti maingi matiri na utheru, na ndikwenda kurora. Urie afisa, na uroe ringi riera-ini.

not_sure.en: Unclear photos are left out of the count. They are never forced into a disease.
not_sure.sw: Picha zisizo wazi hazihesabiwi kama ugonjwa. Hazilazimishwi kuwa ugonjwa.

text.en: I am not sure what these leaves show. Ask the officer. You choose: act, wait, or ask.
text.sw: Sina uhakika majani haya yanaonyesha nini. Uliza afisa wa ugani. Chagua: tenda, subiri, au uliza.
text.kik: Ndiri na uhoro wa mahuti maya. Urie afisa wa urimi. Ucagure wee.

not_sure.en: When the sample does not fit a rule, the answer is to ask a person.
not_sure.sw: Sampuli isipolingana na kanuni, jibu ni kuuliza mtu.

text.en: This tool only looks at leaves. Dark sunken spots on green berries need the officer.
text.sw: Zana hii inaangalia majani tu. Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda mabichi yanahitaji afisa.

not_sure.en: Coffee berry disease is out of scope. Losses can be high, which is why a person must see the berries.
not_sure.sw: Ugonjwa wa matunda ya kahawa hauko katika zana hii. Mtu aone matunda.

text.en: This tool checks coffee leaves only. For maize or beans, ask the officer.
text.sw: Zana hii inaangalia majani ya kahawa tu. Kwa mahindi au maharagwe, uliza afisa.

text.en: Jani keeps photos on this phone. Nothing is sent unless you tap send later. Do you agree?
text.sw: Jani huweka picha katika simu hii, na hakuna kinachotumwa mpaka ubonyeze kutuma baadaye. Unakubali?

text.en: The officer can see these photos only if you say yes. You can say no and still send the short message.
text.sw: Afisa anaona picha hizi tu ukikubali. Unaweza kukataa na bado kutuma ujumbe mfupi.

text.en: You chose to act. Ask the cooperative which product and how much. Wear long sleeves, trousers, boots and gloves, and wash after.
text.sw: Umechagua kutenda. Uliza chama bidhaa na kiasi. Vaa mihono mirefu, suruali, buti na glavu, kisha oga.
text.kik: Niwacagura gwika. Urie andu a gikundi undu wa dawa na wingi. Ukare nguo ndaihu.

text.en: You chose to wait. Check the leaves again next weekend.
text.sw: Umechagua kusubiri. Angalia majani tena wikendi ijayo.
text.kik: Niwacagura gweterera. Rora mahuti ringi wikendi uyu ungi.

text.en: You chose to ask the officer. The message is ready. You press send.
text.sw: Umechagua kuuliza afisa. Ujumbe uko tayari, na wewe unabonyeza kutuma.
text.kik: Niwacagura kuria afisa. Ndumiriri ni tayari. Uhitithie wee.

text.en: The message is ready. It has your member number, not your name. You press send.
text.sw: Ujumbe uko tayari. Una nambari ya mwanachama, si jina lako. Wewe unabonyeza kutuma.
